description.value: Kove Kitchen is a waterfront dine-in restaurant located in the historic fishing village of Steveston, Richmond, with patio seating overlooking the water and a private second-floor event room. The menu leans into comfort and seasonal specials — Ukrainian cabbage rolls, a famous Thanksgiving dinner, and a rotating draft beer selection. For a cycling tourist, the scenic Steveston waterfront location and relaxed atmosphere make it a natural rest stop on the South Dyke Trail corridor.
